newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile Escondida 96 output at 842,030 T - report.
newsitem.headline: Chile Escondida 96 output at 842,030 T - report.

text.p: Chile's Escondida copper mine produced 842,030 tonnes of fine copper in concentrates and cathodes last year, up from 466,913 tonnes in 1995, reported newspaper El Mercurio Friday.
The paper, quoting the mine's general manager Ken Pickering, said sales came to $1.8 billion in 1995.
Escondida expects to receive environmental permission by April to go ahead with its latest project -- the construction of a 125,000-tonne plant to process oxide ores, said Pickering.
The oxides plant will involve an investment of $450 million.
